mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.engine, d.conn_string, d.created_at, d.last_test_at, d.last_test_ok FROM kb_data_sources m JOIN data_sources d ON d.id = m.data_source_id WHERE m.kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY d.name

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.engine, d.conn_string, d.created_at, d.last_test_at, d.last_test_ok FROM data_source_grants g JOIN data_sources d ON d.id = g.data_source_id WHERE g.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY d.name
SELECT id, name, engine, conn_string, created_at, last_test_at, last_test_ok FROM data_sources ORDER BY name
SELECT w.id, w.name FROM data_source_grants g JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = g.workspace_id WHERE g.data_source_id = #{dataSourceId} ORDER BY w.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_source_grants (data_source_id, workspace_id, granted_by) VALUES (#{dataSourceId}, #{workspaceId}, #{grantedBy}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM data_source_grants WHERE data_source_id = #{dataSourceId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_data_sources (kb_id, data_source_id) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{dataSourceId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO data_sources (id, name, engine, conn_string, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{engine}, #{conn}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE data_sources SET last_test_at = now(), last_test_ok = #{ok} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT engine, conn_string FROM data_sources WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_data_sources WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND data_source_id = #{dataSourceId}
